title: Expression edge cases
label: Expression edge cases
checked: Argument rules of row_number() and ntile(); isIn() with dates, datetimes, and times; NaN in coalesce(); one-character pads in str_pad(); parse_date_time() orders without a year; fractional periods; and dates plus clock periods. Results and error conditions on DataFrame, the SQL databases, and Polars.
description: tests/r/edge_cases.R prints R's result or error for each case. The tests hold those results as expected values and check that phibble gives the same value, or raises where R raises. Fixtures regenerated with the listed R versions on 2026-11-01; output byte-identical to the committed files.
reference: R 4.6.1 with dplyr 1.2.1, stringr 1.6.0, and lubridate 1.9.5

inputs.name: edge cases
inputs.detail: Literal vectors in tests/ExprRTest.php and tests/Polars/PolarsExprRTest.php

comparison.applies_to: Values and result types; NA in identical positions, datetimes to the microsecond

known_differences: parse_date_time() with an order that has a day but no month: lubridate returns NA with a warning; phibble raises an error.
Errors where R errors: phibble raises an exception with its own message.
exclusions: isIn() with temporal lists on SQLite and coalesce() of numbers on PostgreSQL run in memory; the results are compared the same way.
